steps.label: GET /users/42
steps.description: The client sends an HTTP request. No logic yet: just a URL and a method.

steps.label: users#show
steps.description: The router finds the matching route and delegates to the right controller.

steps.label: findById(42)
steps.description: The controller knows nothing about SQL: it asks the model, which encapsulates business rules.

steps.label: SELECT ... WHERE id = 42
steps.description: The model turns the request into a database query.

steps.label: User
steps.description: The model hands back an already-validated domain object.

steps.label: render(user)
steps.description: The controller picks the view and passes the data. It does not build the HTML itself.

steps.label: 200 OK + HTML/JSON
steps.description: The view produces the representation and the response goes back to the client.
